title: Your Guide to Thanksgiving Weekend Events in Portland: Tree Lighting, Beatles Night, and Family Activities - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Thanksgiving weekend in Portland, Maine, from November 28 to November 30, 2025, features a range of holiday traditions, community events, and family activities. As the city moves from Thanksgiving to the winter season, both residents and visitors can attend several scheduled events that reflect Portland’s seasonal offerings.
One of the main events is the 23rd Annual Beatles Night at the State Theatre, with performances by Spencer and the Walrus. The event runs for three nights, each focusing on a different period of Beatles music. Friday features a performance of 'Rubber Soul.' Saturday highlights songs from 'Beatles 1.' Sunday offers a matinee aimed at younger audiences. The event brings together community members and fans of the band.
The Portland Festival of Trees also returns and supports the Children’s Dyslexia Center. Visitors can view decorated trees and shop from 30 local vendors selling handmade items such as stained glass, jewelry, and crocheted animals. Proceeds support literacy programs for children in Maine.
Families can attend Disney on Ice Presents Road Trip Adventures at the Cross Insurance Arena. The show includes characters like Mickey, Moana, Simba, and Woody. It combines skating, music, and theatrical elements. The event is open to all ages, but costumes are not allowed for guests 14 and older.
Friday includes Portland’s Annual Tree Lighting Celebration at Monument Square. Activities start at 4 PM and include free hot cocoa, a photobooth, and entertainment from MC Donny Pelletier. The event features a screening of 'Elf,' a Buddy the Elf look-alike contest, and a performance by The Pine State Pitches. The tree lighting is scheduled for 6:30 PM. For those seeking a quieter activity, Rosemont Wellness Center offers a morning yoga class. The Maine State Ballet’s production of 'The Nutcracker,' directed by Janet Davis, continues at Merrill Auditorium with traditional choreography, costumes, and live music.
